Confidential
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 2817 Special Branch S. Z. Station, Date 10. 11. 31 Date November 9, 1931）
Subject (in full) E.L. Fullerton.
Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Everest.
Inquiries regarding E.L. Fullerton reveal that he arrived in Shanghai from San Francisco on July 3, 1931, as a passenger on the s.s. "Golden Star". Following his arrival he resided at the Savoy Hotel, Broadway, registering as Major Fullerton. On August 18 he moved to No.31c Central Arcade, sharing rooms with a Mr. E.F. O'Connor, manager of the local office of Metro Goldwyn Mayer, who had occupied this address since September 1, 1930. The extent of Mr. O'Connor's friendship with Fullerton is not known, but it is known that relations between them grew rather strained towards the end of September and that Mr. O'Connor left the apartment suddenly and paid one month's rent to the agents in lieu of notice.
Fullerton continued living in 31c until October 7 when he removed to 691 Avenue Joffre, apartment No.3, where he is at present residing. He is on the editorial staff of the North China Daily News and has been so employed since July 23.
Further information regarding Fullerton is that he was born in Vancouver in 1893 and educated at Kingston. Previous to 1914 he was employed in the service of the Russian Consulate in Vancouver as a courier between Vancouver and St. Petersberg, Russia. He speaks fluent Russian. During the Great War, 1914-1918, he served as a Major with the Canadian Scottish and the 183 Brigade. He possesses the "Mons Star". Since 1918 he has been engaged in newspaper work and has been with the "Vancouver Sun", the "Winnipeg Free Press" and the "San Francisco Journal".
I have been unable to verify the information that he receives "shady visitors" and so far as can be ascertained he has no connection with local soviet citizens.
（批：F.J.G. 29/11/31）
Officer i/c Special Branch.
D.S.I.
（签名：D.S.I. Everest）

机密
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事与特别股 登记号 S. B. D. 2817 特别股 苏州路捕房，日期 31年11月10日 日期 1931年11月9日）
事由（全称） E.L. Fullerton。
由副督察长 Everest 制作并呈报。
关于 E.L. Fullerton 的调查显示，他于 1931 年 7 月 3 日作为乘客乘坐“金星”号轮船（s.s. "Golden Star"）从旧金山抵达上海。抵达后，他住在百老汇路的萨伏伊酒店（Savoy Hotel），登记姓名为 Fullerton 少校。8 月 18 日，他搬至中央商场 31c 号，与 E.F. O'Connor 先生合住，O'Connor 先生是米高梅电影公司（Metro Goldwyn Mayer）本地办事处的经理，自 1930 年 9 月 1 日起便居住于此。O'Connor 先生与 Fullerton 的交情深浅不详，但已知他们在 9 月底关系变得相当紧张，且 O'Connor 先生突然离开公寓，并向代理商支付了一个月的租金以代替通知期。
Fullerton 继续居住在 31c 号直至 10 月 7 日，随后搬至霞飞路 691 号 3 室公寓，目前居住于此。他是《字林西报》（North China Daily News）编辑部的成员，自 7 月 23 日起受雇于此。
关于 Fullerton 的进一步信息是，他于 1893 年出生于温哥华，在金斯顿（Kingston）接受教育。1914 年之前，他在温哥华的俄罗斯领事馆任职，担任温哥华与俄罗斯圣彼得堡之间的信使。他能说流利的俄语。在 1914-1918 年的大战期间，他在加拿大苏格兰团和第 183 旅服役，军衔为少校。他拥有“蒙斯星章”（Mons Star）。自 1918 年以来，他一直从事新闻工作，曾就职于《温哥华太阳报》（Vancouver Sun）、《温尼伯自由新闻报》（Winnipeg Free Press）和《旧金山日报》（San Francisco Journal）。
我未能核实他接待“可疑访客”的信息，就目前已查明的情况而言，他与当地的苏维埃公民没有任何联系。
（批注：F.J.G. 31年11月29日）
特别股主管警官。
副督察长。
（签名：副督察长 Everest）
